test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_signal_allocator.py tests/test_target_portfolio.py tests/test_forecast_hurdle.py tests/test_phase5_scanners.py
test.result: 41 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Higher calibrated forecast uncertainty lowers the allocator score and exposure; uncalibrated uncertainty blocks entry when scaling is enabled.

implemented: NetAlpha can carry a non-negative forecast uncertainty estimate with explicit calibration identity.
The common allocator accepts a non-negative uncertainty multiplier and uses net alpha minus z times uncertainty as the entry score.
When uncertainty scaling is requested, missing calibration identity fails closed; the raw and adjusted forecast values remain in the candidate observation.
Uncertainty can only reduce the forecast score; no rule increases exposure to meet a target profit.
blockers: The allocator multiplier and uncertainty calibration are not yet frozen/pinned with a validated forecasting model for every strategy.
No calibrated uncertainty coverage or empirical size-response validation has been collected on prospective paper sessions.
System-wide strategy adapter and durable journal integration are incomplete.
scope_note: Uncertainty scaling and fail-closed calibration contract are implemented in the shared allocator. Strategy-specific calibration and forward validation are outstanding.
